2. Notification under S.4 of the Land Acquisition Act was issued on of 1.8.2008 for acquisition of land measuring 0-35-67 hectares situate in Up Mohal Bharot, Tehsil Jubbal, District Shimla,
Himachal Pradesh.

rt and award was passed by Collector, Land Acquisition, Himachal Pradesh Power Corporation Limited on 31.3.2011 and an amount of Rs.55,56,259/- was awarded in favour of the appellants, to which appellants laid challenged by way of reference under S.18 of the Act ibid.

Learned reference court, after having taken note of previous award dated 585, dated 18.7.2007, whereby compensation at the rate of Rs.920.0 per centare for Kiar Abal land was awarded, passed the award under challenge, holding appellants entitled to the compensation as taken note hereinabove.

3. Before the appeal could heard and decided on merit, Mr. Vivek Negi, Advocate, appearing for respondent No.3-Corporation stated that the dispute raised in the present appeal has been settled by this Court in a bunch of appeal titled Himachal Pradesh Power Corporation Limited and another v. Narayan Singh and others, RFA No. 368 of 2014 & CO NO. 7 of 2015, decided on 12.10.2018,
alongwith connected matters, whereby this Court classified the lands in three lots namely 'A', 'B' and 'C' and in lot 'C' appeals pertaining to land acquired by way of awards Nos. 614 dated 12.7.2010, No.
632, dated 14.6.2011 .
and 631, dated 20.5.2011, were dealt with and this court, while taking note of dates of issuance of Notifications for acquisition, held claimants under lot 'C' entitled for compensation at the rate of Rs.3024/- per centiare and the award impugned herein i.e. No. 622 dated 31.3.2011 in proximity to Narender Kumar And Others vs The State Of Himachal Pradesh And Others on 8 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184171753/
2 the awards dealt under lot 'C' of the decision dated of 12.10.2018, as such, market value of the land of the appellants herein, would govern by the value determined by this court under lot 'C'.
